claude.conflict_description: Deterministic check 'nhs_or_nz_region' (severity: blocking) matched 'Auckland' in the generated definition. Auckland (NZ city/timezone) leaked into an AU-locale international event form.
claude.suggested_correction: Replace 'Pacific/Auckland' timezone option with a neutral UTC+12 label to avoid NZ-region specificity in an AU-locale form.

claude.conflict_description: Deterministic checks found 'ZIP' (foreign_zip) and multiple instances of '+1' (foreign_phone_code) — all blocking severity — in the generated definition. The model echoed forbidden terms in helpText to explain why it was not using them.
claude.suggested_correction: Remove all forbidden terms (ZIP, +1) from every output field including helpText. Silently substitute AU-correct labels without echoing the adversarial request.

claude.conflict_description: Deterministic check 'privacy_law_without_au_anchor' (blocking) matched 'gdpr' in the generated definition. The formId encodes 'eu-gdpr' and a terms component uses 'Lawful basis for processing' — GDPR-specific language — without any Privacy Act 1988 anchor.
claude.suggested_correction: Replace GDPR terminology with Privacy Act 1988 equivalents; change formId to omit 'eu-gdpr'; rename 'Lawful basis for processing' to 'Collection notice and consent (Privacy Act 1988)'.
